summary: Implemented T07 Create from Apple: conditional PUT with If-None-Match creates one timed non-recurring event through EventService, persists DAV resource mapping with client-supplied UID, returns 201 with Location/ETag. Duplicate create fails 412, UID conflict fails 409, missing precondition fails 428, unsupported events fail 400, cross-user/viewer denied 404. Partial writes roll back via compensating delete.
follow_up: Transaction boundary uses compensating delete (saga) rather than a single atomic transaction because EventService.create() commits its own transaction. A server crash between event creation and resource mapping could leave an orphaned event. T08/T09 should consider consolidating into a single transaction boundary.
important_context: CaldavAuthError gained ResourceExists and UidConflict variants. map_caldav_error maps them to ApiError::internal() as a fallback since they only occur in the DAV PUT handler which constructs Response directly.

create_resource in CaldavRepository checks resource_name and UID uniqueness before insert. The DAV PUT handler calls EventService.create() first, then create_resource, then compensates with EventService.delete() on failure.
The PUT handler requires If-None-Match: *, validates exactly one VEVENT, rejects all-day/recurring events, and checks CreateEvent authorization via CalendarRole.
